claim.quote: In an analysis window of 80-200 keV recoil energy, based on a 35.7 g-day exposure, we set a 90% C.L. upper limit on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section of 2.0 x 10^{-33} cm^{2} for 115 GeV/c^2 dark matter particle mass.

key_value.note: 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit at 115 GeV/c^2 (surface run).
key_value.quote: 2.0 x 10^{-33} cm^{2} for 115 GeV/c^2 dark matter particle mass

name: First Dark Matter Search Results from a Surface Run of the 10-L DMTPC Directional Dark Matter Detector

summary.plain: DMTPC's first dark matter limit came from a short run of its 10-litre detector in an MIT basement. It excluded spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross sections above 2.0e-33 cm^2 for a 115 GeV/c^2 particle.
summary.technical: 10-L, 75 Torr CF4, surface run at MIT, 35.7 g d, 80-200 keV recoil window: 90% CL spin-dependent WIMP-proton limit 2.0e-33 cm^2 at 115 GeV/c^2 (zero expected background assumed, Feldman-Cousins).

title: First Dark Matter Search Results from a Surface Run of the 10-L DMTPC Directional Dark Matter Detector
why_it_matters: It is described in the abstract as the first dark matter limit from DMTPC; the detector was then moved underground.
